title: Sir Peter Horsley approached by Nordics Miss Markham and Mr. Janus

tellings.quote: was approached by these Nordics who basically uh invited him to a fireside chat Miss Markham and Mr. Janice

plain: In the 1950s the British officer Sir Peter Horsley was approached by Nordics, human-looking beings with fair features described in UFO stories, and invited to a "fireside chat" with a Miss Markham and a Mr. Janus. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this as something he has read, crediting a book called Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean a senior British figure believed he had met visitors posing as ordinary people.
